gemini-3-flash.notes: Strong CRA alignment with correct Article 14 assessment and detailed compliance actions. Accurate CVE counts and EPSS values. Comprehensive coverage but slightly verbose at ~600 words.

gpt-4.1-mini.notes: Good CRA compliance coverage but less detailed on Article references. Accurate data presentation. Well-structured but actionability could be more specific with version recommendations.

deepseek-v3.notes: Excellent CRA alignment with specific Article citations. Accurate data and good completeness. Outstanding conciseness at 450 words. Clear, prioritized actions with specific compliance references.

analysis: Deepseek-v3 wins with superior conciseness (450 words vs ~600) while maintaining excellent CRA alignment through specific Article citations and accurate technical details. All models correctly identified no CRA Article 14 triggers, but Deepseek provided the most actionable guidance with clear compliance references.
